archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for Healthcare (Clinical Clarity + Trust)

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-tight

guidelines: Headings should strictly avoid generic sans-serifs like Inter.
Use Outfit for a modern SaaS tech-forward look.
Maintain tight tracking on headings (tracking-tight) to ensure professional typesetting.
Use high contrast colors for typography.
Use primary Indigo (#4F46E5) for all primary actions and CTAs.
Secondary Sky Blue (#0EA5E9) for accents, abstract UI highlights, and secondary icons.
Background should alternate between pure white (#FFFFFF) and Slate 50 (#F8FAFC) to create visual separation between sections.

surfaces.card: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300

motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Use Framer Motion to fade up elements on scroll (initial={opacity: 0, y: 20} whileInView={opacity: 1, y: 0})
guidelines: Add micro-interactions to feature cards and pricing tiers.
Use staggered entrances for lists and grids.

header.elements: Logo, Navigation Links (Desktop), Mobile Hamburger, Primary CTA button

hero.layout: Two-column. Left: Typography + CTA. Right: Abstract UI Mockup + Lifestyle image overlapping.
hero.mock_ui: Build a custom HTML/Tailwind mockup of a care scheduling dashboard with floating widgets showing 'Upcoming Shifts', 'Claim Status', and 'Patient Vitals'.

problem_solution.visuals: Red/Orange tint for Problem (Old Way), Green/Indigo tint for Solution (GRATEHCARE Way).

features_bento.layout: Bento Grid layout. 5 items: Smart Scheduling, Billing & Claims, Compliance & Audit, Care Management, AI Insights.
features_bento.styling: Card surfaces with slight hover lift. Include bullet points and small abstract graphics/icons for each.

how_it_works.elements: Step 1, Step 2, Step 3 with connecting dashed lines or progressive numbered circles.

role_based_audience.items: Owners, Admins, Coordinators, Support Workers, Billing, Compliance, Families, Practitioners.

social_proof.layout: Marquee or Swiper carousel of testimonial cards.
social_proof.styling: White cards, quote text, avatar image, name, and role.

pricing.styling: Highlight the middle 'Growth' tier with Indigo borders, subtle scale (transform scale-105 on lg screens), and a 'Most Popular' badge.

hero_lifestyle.description: Caregiver interacting warmly with an elderly patient. Use in hero section with a floating UI card over it.

abstract_tech_dashboard.description: Clean medical/tech background for abstract UI accents or Feature Section backgrounds.

data_analytics.description: Sleek futuristic interface. Use this inside the 'AI Insights' or 'Billing & Claims' feature card as a decorative image.

icons.usage: Use clear, outline icons. Stroke width 1.5 or 2. Primary brand color for accents.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets at least 4.5:1 ratio on backgrounds. Avoid white text on light indigo; use Slate-900.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
accessibility.focus: Implement focus-visible styles for keyboard navigation (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:ring-offset-2).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the color palette. No neon or cyberpunk colors.
Build the dashboard mockup in the hero section using pure Tailwind HTML. It should look like a floating SaaS calendar and metric card.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Ensure 'Outfit' is imported via Google Fonts in index.css.
Make the 'Growth' pricing tier visually dominant.
Use Framer Motion for section entry animations (fade in and slide up).
In the Role-Based section, keep the design clean and icon-driven rather than photo-heavy to maintain SaaS feel.
Never use placeholder image URLs like via.placeholder.com. Use the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs.
